This text engine was made by @BlasterOps

Alright. Here's how it works, first of all, you need to have a separate sprite constantly broadcasting tick, otherwise certain parts of it might not work.

D^X/AA^m~QZDsz97;9Lp.text:
The first bubble is what is said. Add whatever you like to it, and in most cases it'll say it. If the letters/symbols are funky, that means that they haven't been added yet, you can add those in the costumes, and make sure to name the costume the same letter.

The Second Bubble is who is speaking (kinda Undertale Style). If you want to add a Speaker, create 2 Costumes with a name in this format:

1st costume: Speaker + (number or name of speaker here) 

2nd costume: SpeakerTalk + (number or name of speaker here) 

(no spaces)^

The Third Bubble is for emotions of the same speaker. You don't have to put anything in here unless you put an emotion into the name of a speaker.  Example: Speakerhappy1
happy would have to be in the name of the costume, and you would add "happy" to the third bubble.

The fourth and final bubble is how long the message is broadcasted, or if you want it to be there till you press space.
Put "space" into the bubble if you want it to be there until space is pressed, otherwise put in a number for how many seconds it will last after it finishes inputting letters/symbols.
